# TestScript for 18-config-searchpaths
# Asserts ConfigSearchPaths single-file (first-found) mode

env HOME=$WORK/home
env SYSCONF_DIR=$WORK/etc/firstfound

# 1. First-found mode: first existing search path wins, no merging
exec firstfound
stdout '⚙  firstfound'
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+firstfound\.hcl\s+● config firstfound\.hcl'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+local-region\s+● config firstfound\.hcl'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+local\s+● config firstfound\.hcl'

# 2. --why reports the first-found candidate and the probed locations of the
#    remaining tiers
exec firstfound --why
stdout '--region\s+local-region\s+config \(firstfound\.hcl\)'
stdout 'loaded: firstfound\.hcl'
stdout 'no config file'
stdout 'looked for: .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl'
! stdout '██████'

# 3. First-found mode skips missing files and picks the next existing one
rm firstfound.hcl
exec firstfound
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+.*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl\s+● config .*firstfound\.hcl'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+user-region\s+● config .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+user\s+● config .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl'

# 4. Explicit -c overrides the search list entirely
exec firstfound -c etc/firstfound/firstfound.hcl
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+etc[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+system-region\s+● config etc[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+system\s+● config etc[/\\]firstfound[/\\]firstfound\.hcl'

# 5. No config file found at all: struct defaults apply
rm home/.config/firstfound/firstfound.hcl
rm etc/firstfound/firstfound.hcl
exec firstfound
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+us-east-1\s+· default'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+standby\s+· default'

-- etc/firstfound/firstfound.hcl --
region = "system-region"
mode = "system"

-- home/.config/firstfound/firstfound.hcl --
region = "user-region"
mode = "user"

-- firstfound.hcl --
region = "local-region"
mode = "local"
